78105 [See DMG memo 12/23] An additional amount for carers may be awarded for each claimant 1 or, in

the case of partners, each partner2 who is


1. entitled to CA3 or


2. treated as still satisfying the qualifying conditions for the award of the additional amount 4 (see DMG
78107).
